title: Orchestration Backend Selection
description: Records which orchestration backend (tier) was chosen for a task and why, so degradation is auditable

chosen.description: The backend tier selected to execute the task.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the selection (e.g. availability, opt-out, pin, capability fit).

considered.description: Backends evaluated during selection, in preference order. The chosen backend should appear in this list.

opt_out.description: True when the caller explicitly opted out of higher-capability tiers, forcing degradation.

pin.description: Operator pin overriding auto-selection. Empty string or null means auto (no pin).
